style_prefix: Premium realistic restaurant menu photography for a modern Egyptian restaurant in Cairo. Square 1:1 composition. One single named dish or drink as the clear hero, centered and fully visible, authentic ingredients and plating, warm natural window light, elegant cream or stone tableware, subtle teal and warm brass accents, shallow depth of field, appetizing true-to-life texture, polished editorial food photography, consistent visual language across the whole menu. No text, no typography, no logos, no people, no hands, no collage, no borders, no duplicated plates, no unrelated props. Depict the named item and described ingredients accurately.
